title: New chart panel: Relative Strength Index (RSI)
description: Surface RSI (backend-indicator-rsi) as a new oscillator panel or an additional line on the existing OscillatorChart, alongside Stochastic. Explain, not just plot, the comparison Elder himself draws: RSI is closing-price-only and tends to give earlier/cleaner signals than Stochastic on the same data -- worth stating in the help content so a user understands why both exist rather than treating it as redundant. Per the project's established explanatory pattern (common/InfoBalloon, common/MetricHelp, metricHelpContent.ts, signalExplanation.ts, docs/tasks/frontend-stock-detail-metric-help.json), every new visual element this task adds must be explainable, not just displayed: a help affordance (reuse MetricHelp where it fits) that states what the metric/signal is, how it relates to Dr. Elder's methodology, and, where meaningful, an explanation of the CURRENT value shown -- not a static definition alone. Add an entry to metricHelpContent.ts's registry rather than inventing a parallel explanation mechanism.

checklist.step: Decide whether RSI becomes a new OscillatorChart variant or an additional series on the existing Stochastic panel; record.
Implement, following existing chart component conventions.
MetricHelp content explaining RSI, its formula in plain terms, and the RSI-vs-Stochastic comparison from the book.
Tests + Storybook story; confirm 90% coverage gate holds.
